info.name: feed-api
info.description:
All feed-api endpoints, one folder per route file (internal/routes/*_routes.go).

1. Start the API: go run ./cmd
2. Set the baseUrl collection variable if your server is not http://localhost:8080
3. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (requests run in order; some depend on earlier ones).
4. Test rows (vendors with external_id postman-test-*, product-hierarchy test departments) stay in the DB; delete them manually if needed.

Product Hierarchies scenarios 4, 5, 6 and 8 only show "inserted" on the first run.

Products: test rows (TEST-SKU-0001/0002, brand TESTBRANDAPI) are removed with the cleanup SQL in the Products folder description. S4 and S10 only show "inserted" when the test SKUs do not exist yet.

Product UPCs: test rows (upc 999000000001-4) are removed with the cleanup SQL in the Product UPCs folder description.

BOH: run the cleanup SQL in the BOH folder description after testing; it restores the original store_products values.

Deliveries: run the cleanup SQL in the Deliveries folder description after testing (test ASNs 990000001-3 and the activity logs).

Stocktake: run the cleanup SQL in the Stocktake folder description after testing; it restores the location quantities.

Product Variants: run DELETE FROM product_variant WHERE variant LIKE 'TEST-VAR-%'; after testing.

POS: run the cleanup SQL in the POS folder description after testing; it restores stock, counters and picklists.

item.name: Queue (Service Bus)
item.description:
One set of routes for every queue; the queue name is in the URL (or ?queue= for dead-letter). No token header.

Queues: vendor, product-hierarchies, products, product-upcs, boh, deliveries, stocktake, product-variants, pos.

POST /queue/:name/process?max=0                     e.g. /queue/vendor/process, /queue/product-hierarchies/process, /queue/products/process, /queue/product-upcs/process, /queue/boh/process, /queue/deliveries/process, /queue/stocktake/process, /queue/product-variants/process, /queue/pos/process
GET  /queue/deadletter?queue=:name                  e.g. ?queue=vendor, ?queue=product-hierarchies, ?queue=products, ?queue=product-upcs, ?queue=boh, ?queue=deliveries, ?queue=stocktake, ?queue=product-variants, ?queue=pos
